description.en: Pasta is type of noodle typically made from an unleavened dough of durum wheat flour mixed with water or eggs, and formed into sheets or various shapes, then cooked by boiling or baking. Rice flour, or legumes such as beans or lentils, are sometimes used in place of wheat flour to yield a different taste and texture, or as a gluten-free alternative. Pasta is a staple food of Italian cuisine.

description.en: A JUNIPER BERRY is the female seed cone produced by the various species of junipers. Juniper berries are used in northern European and particularly Scandinavian cuisine to "impart a sharp, clear flavor" to meat dishes. Besides Norwegian and Swedish dishes, juniper berries are also sometimes used in German, Austrian, Czech, Polish and Hungarian cuisine, often with roasts -such as German sauerbraten-. Northern Italian cuisine, especially that of the South Tyrol, also incorporates juniper berries.

description.en: Native to Mexico and Guatemala, chia seeds come from the flowering plant Salvia hispanica. Black seeds are the traditional, more widely available variety; white seeds are a naturally occurring lighter variant, often prized for their appearance in pale-colored dishes. Both share a mild, nutty flavor and neutral taste, absorbing surrounding flavors easily. When soaked, they develop a gel-like texture, making them ideal for puddings, smoothies, baked goods, and as an egg substitute. Nutritionally identical, both are rich in fiber, plant-based omega-3s, protein, calcium, and antioxidants — a versatile, nutrient-dense addition to any diet.

description.en: Black garlic is aged whole garlic -Allium sativum-, traditionally associated with East Asia, particularly Korea, Japan and Thailand, and now produced and used worldwide. Fresh bulbs are held for several weeks at controlled high temperature -about 60-90°C- and humidity, without additives. The Maillard reaction turns the cloves black, soft and sticky. The taste is sweet and savoury with umami notes, reminiscent of balsamic vinegar, molasses and tamarind, and without raw garlic's sharpness. It is used in sauces, dressings, spreads, marinades, risotto, meat dishes and desserts. Nutritionally, it contains natural sugars, amino acids, and antioxidant compounds such as polyphenols, with minimal fat.

The most commonly used cake ingredients include flour, sugar, eggs, butter or oil or margarine, a liquid, and leavening agents, such as baking soda or baking powder. description.en: Fennel -Foeniculum vulgare- is a flowering plant species in the carrot family. The bulb, foliage, and fruits of the fennel plant are used in many of the culinary traditions of the world. The bulb is a crisp vegetable that can be sautéed, stewed, braised, grilled, or eaten raw. Young tender leaves are used for garnishes, as a salad, to add flavor to salads, to flavor sauces to be served with puddings, and also in soups and fish sauce.

description.lt: Industriinis alus dažnai gaminamas visiškai automatizuotu procesu. Šio tipo alus paprastai gaminamas didelės apimties aludarių, priklausančių korporacijoms, ir yra pigesnis gaminti už sąskaitą prastam skoniui ir kokybei.
description.fr: La bière industrielle est souvent fabriquée selon un processus entièrement automatisé. Ce type de bière est généralement produit par de grandes brasseries appartenant à des corporations et est moins cher à produire au détriment du goût et de la qualité médiocres.
description.es: La cerveza industrial se produce a menudo en un proceso completamente automatizado. Este tipo de cerveza suele ser producida por cervecerías a gran escala propiedad de corporaciones y es más barata de producir a expensas de un sabor y calidad pobres.
description.en: Industrial beer is often made in fully automated process. This type of beer is usually produced by large-scale breweries owned by corporations and is cheaper to produce at the expense of poor taste and quality.
description.pl: Piwo przemysłowe jest często produkowane w w pełni zautomatyzowanym procesie. Ten rodzaj piwa jest zwykle produkowany przez duże browary należące do korporacji i jest tańszy w produkcji kosztem słabego smaku i jakości.
description.nl: Industrieel bier wordt vaak gemaakt in volledig geautomatiseerde processen. Dit type bier wordt meestal geproduceerd door grootschalige brouwerijen die eigendom zijn van bedrijven en is goedkoper om te produceren ten koste van een slechte smaak en kwaliteit.
description.hu: Az ipari sörök gyakran teljesen automatizált folyamatban készülnek. Ez a típusú sör általában nagyüzemi sörfőzdékben készül, amelyeket vállalatok birtokolnak, és olcsóbban állítható elő a rossz íz és minőség rovására.
description.it: La birra industriale viene spesso prodotta con processi completamente automatizzati. Questo tipo di birra è solitamente prodotto da birrifici su larga scala di proprietà di grandi aziende e ha un costo inferiore a discapito del gusto e della qualità scadenti.
description.de: Industriebier wird oft in vollautomatisierten Prozessen hergestellt. Diese Art von Bier wird in der Regel von Großbrauereien produziert, die im Besitz von Unternehmen sind, und ist kostengünstiger, jedoch auf Kosten von Geschmack und Qualität.
